_comment: Minimum tests that must EXECUTE per project. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; never lower one to make a run pass. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole, and verify-test-run checks that sum on every invocation, on both operating systems. AiDe.Core.Tests.nonportable is Platform=Windows (129, genuinely locked: kernel32, powershell, the net10.0-windows daemon) plus Platform=Unverified (104, fails on Linux with the cause undiagnosed - see INV-0005). Moving a class out of Unverified lowers nonportable and raises portable by the same amount; the total may not move.
